item.title: Rupee slips to 90.56 against dollar as fund outflows persist
item.description: The rupee fell to a fresh record low on Friday, slipping 24 paise to 90.56 against the US dollar in early trade, as uncertainty surrounding the India–US trade deal and continued foreign fund outflows weighed on investor sentiment.

item.title: FIFA faces backlash as World Cup 2026 ticket prices spark fan outrage
item.description: FIFA is facing backlash after 2026 World Cup ticket prices were revealed via national associations, with fans calling the costs a “monumental betrayal.”

item.title: Structural imbalance in India’s electoral battlefield, says Ajay Maken citing BJP’s massive funding advantage
item.description: Senior Congress leader Ajay Maken raises alarm over India’s skewed electoral landscape, exposing BJP’s 75x funding advantage and accusing the Election Commission of partisanship. #ElectoralReforms #IndiaElections #Democracy

item.title: At least nine dead as bus overturns on ghat road in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: At least nine people were killed and 22 others injured after a bus overturned on a ghat road in Alluri Sitaramarajud district in the early hours of Friday, police said.

item.title: Awami League rejects Bangladesh election schedule, accuses interim government of bias
item.description: Bangladesh’s Awami League has rejected the election schedule announced by the country’s Election Commission (EC), claiming that free and fair polls cannot be conducted under the Muhammad Yunus-led interim government.

item.title: Congress leaders mourn passing of senior leader Shivraj Patil
item.description: Senior Congress leaders mourn the passing of Shivraj Patil, former Union Home Minister and 10th Lok Sabha Speaker, who died at 90 in Latur, Maharashtra, following a brief illness.

item.title: Cong slams Amit Shah’s ‘Vote Chori’ charge, cites Rajmohan Gandhi to set record straight
item.description: Congress rejects Amit Shah’s “vote chori” charge against Nehru, calling it a “blatant lie,” and cites historian Rajmohan Gandhi to rebut the claim

item.title: Delhi HC gives social media platforms seven days to protect Sunil Gavaskar’s personality rights
item.description: Delhi High Court directs social media platforms to act within seven days on Sunil Gavaskar’s plea to protect his personality rights, marking a crucial move against unauthorized use of public figures’ images and names.

item.title: Leopard roaming Pune Airport since April safely captured after tunnel operation
item.description: A male leopard that had been roaming inside Pune Airport since April was safely tranquilised and captured on Friday in a coordinated multi-agency operation, forest officials said.

item.title: DGCA removes four flight inspection officers amid scrutiny over IndiGo disruptions
item.description: The DGCA has removed four flight inspection officers amid its crackdown following IndiGo’s widespread disruptions, raising questions over the regulator’s oversight of the airline’s pilot strength and its approval of a 10% winter schedule increase.
